export.title: Export and import
export.authorized: Identity confirmed. You can export or import for five minutes.
export.notice: Use a strong passphrase of 12–128 characters. Losing it loses access to the export; keep it separately. Import into a fully set-up account. Existing records or different settings cause the whole import to be refused.
export.safety: Spend credentials and vault keys are never exported. Stop using the source instance before spending from its replacement. Imported nodes need credentials, fresh chain checks and spending reconciliation. Unresolved on-chain spends may need manual node inspection because PSBTs are excluded.
export.invalidFile: Select a valid export file no larger than 6 MiB.
export.failed: The operation could not be confirmed. Check the file, passphrase and destination conflicts. If the reply was lost, check destination data before retrying.
export.success: Import completed. Imported nodes need fresh checks and spend credentials.
